_readme: Every TCP port on which a test of this workspace starts a local node, in one place. A group is a package,
named by its workspace path; `shared` is the default anvil port, used one suite at a time by the hardhat
e2e suites and the consumer tests.
Each group has a `range`, first and last port included, that no other group touches: two packages can
never meet on a port, and a new port needs no look at the other groups. Groups are listed by increasing
range, and the ports of a group by increasing number. The current cleartext generation fills its range
from the first port, one by one: a new test takes the next number.
A test reads its port from here with `testPort(group, name)` of @fhevm/sdk-common-dev; it never spells a
number. Two kinds of source cannot read this file, so their numbers are recorded here and a test holds
the two together: the previous cleartext generation, which is frozen, and the npm scripts of
forge-fhevm-std. That is why the previous generation has gaps. One of its ports serves two suites that
run one after the other, and is one entry here.
Not listed: a port the OS assigns at run time, and the node a generator starts (`generate:genesis`).
At a rotation of the cleartext pair, the incoming generation gets a group with a new range, the outgoing
one keeps its range and its numbers and loses the names of the suites it deletes, and the group of the
`fhevm-npm check test-ports` enforces all of the above.
